This '''BX-series droid commando''' was among the reinforcements sent to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]]. When the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebels]] took refuge in the mountains, this droid commando reported this to Kalani and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]].
While forces were sent into the highlands to deal the final blow to the rebellion, this droid remained with Kalani, Rash, and [[Okalin/Legends|Okalin]] to protect them from the rebelling citizens of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. The rebels were given [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] by the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] which helped them defeat the separatist forces.
Back at the palace, this droid saw as King Rash demanded more reinforcements from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However, Dooku ordered Kalani to evacuate the planet with whatever forces he had left. Rash was shot and Kalani and his surviving forces, this droid included, fled from Onderon before harm could be done to them.
